chunks: Abi (may Allah have mercy on him) from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Hassam from his father [from] Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who spits in a mosque and then swallows it, any disease that passes through him will be cured by it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and benefit of swallowing one's spit in the mosque?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith highlights the reverence due to mosques by preserving the purity of the space, as swallowing phlegm avoids the need for others to remove it. It uniquely links this physical etiquette to a spiritual and medicinal benefit, asserting that the act serves as a cure for any disease, reflecting the Shia belief in the interconnection of bodily purity and divine healing.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. Abi (rah) from Abdillah b. Ja’far from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ahmad from his father [from] Abdillah b. Sinan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who does not spit in mosque and swallows it, would soon be cured of the disease from which he is suffering.”
